111.news_title: Arcooda at Asia Parks & Attractions Expo in Guangzhou China
111.long_description:
We were exhibiting today at the Asia Parks & Attractions Expo in Guangzhou China  showing our Tempest upright cabinet. 

The Tempest upright cabinet will go into production next month with shipping towards end of July. It offers many options including console/PC support, gun shooter, coin operated, dual monitors and more. Add your own customer graphics or theme with your company’s logo…

Please visit us at booth 8Q109.
